facts.claim: Norwegian Pearl (Norwegian Cruise Line): Entered service 2006; 93,530 GT; 2394 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 294 m length; Jewel class.
Norwegian Pearl is a Jewel-class cruise ship of Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL), launched in 2006, sailing itineraries primarily around Alaska and the Caribbean.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Norwegian Cruise Line; entered service 2006; 110,000 GT; approx. 2,394 guests.
